derivation: SPEC Time: fade-in starts at zero opacity, zero opacity is transparent so every cell is a normal space at t=0; simple duration P=2 (greatest action end), repeat 1, done = time>=2. At t=2 the final value (opacity 1) is frozen and held; full opacity keeps the named colour 'normal' (SPEC Cells); at t=7 still held, done stays true. (No mid-fade time is used here to avoid the blend; see obs_fade_blend_*.)
